notes: Tier shelf, no archetypes. Old k50 'Smoke and CO alarm' merged into Smoke alarm as a type ('combined smoke + CO'); its SC5 model carried over. Smoke alarm trimmed to 12 models (dropped Kidde 20SD10 as Kidde already has two entries). Old FireAngel One Smart BLE models dropped: the current FireAngel site lists Pro Connected as the smart range and I could not retrieve a page confirming the 'One' line still exists (Thermistek Kitchen Heat Alarm kept from old data). Smoke alarm models = market-covering brands (FireAngel, Aico, Kidde, First Alert, Google Nest, X-Sense, Hispec) plus Consumer Reports top scorers reported via azfamily.com (Kidde i9070, SimpliSafe SSSD3) and CR pressroom listings (First Alert SMCO210); FA3322 CO alarm is a Which? Best Buy per FireAngel's own page; Kidde Nighthawk from This Old House review. Gas detector kept to two retrieved consumer models (Kidde KN-COEG-3, FireAngel NG-9B); the old ManoMano SKU was dropped as retail noise. Water-leak detector covers stand-alone/smart (Govee, Aqara, Honeywell Lyric) and shut-off valve systems (Moen Flo, Grohe Sense Guard, Phyn Plus); whole-home shut-off valves are plumbed in and could arguably sit in Home Fixtures, flagged for the coordinator. SimpliSafe has no brand entry because I did not retrieve a brand page. No X-Sense CO-only model listed as no page was retrieved. Nest Protect sourced to the Google Nest Wikipedia article (the Google Store page did not render product text). Brand founding years left blank where not confirmed on a retrieved page.
